events.overview: Celebrating the legacy of musical theatre and the artists who continue to shape its future, Yesterday’s Legends to Tomorrow’s Stars pays tribute to the generations of composers, lyricists, performers and storytellers who have paved the way for today’s emerging talent. From the groundbreaking genius of Stephen Sondheim to the unmistakable songwriting and performance excellence of Dolly Parton, this showcase honors the diverse voices, timeless stories, and musical innovations and styles that have influenced generations.
